title: AW28 Men's Material Innovations
summary: Material innovations for AW28 men: lighter wools, hidden performance suiting, chrome-free leather and suede.
research_period: AW28/29 colour previews (October 2026), AW27 fairs (September 2026), SS28 previews

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Long-range projection. AW28 fabric fairs take place in September 2027 and the shows in early 2028. This report projects from the first AW28/29 colour forecasts, the AW27 fabric fairs, SS28 previews and long-term market and regulatory drivers. Forecut will update it as evidence arrives.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body: - AW27 fairs made wool lighter and softer, brought back double-faced woollens and hid performance inside classic suitings<sup>[1]</sup>

sections.heading: Readiness
sections.body:
| Material | Readiness (Forecut assessment) |
|---|---|
| Lighter wools | Ready |
| Hidden performance suiting | Ready |
| Chrome-free leather | Ready |

design_implications: - Prefer proven materials; trial new ones in small runs.

sources.title: Première Vision Paris: what fabrics reveal about AW27/28 trends
